resources.string: I\'m beta testing WeatherAPP Libre, a private ad-free weather and natural-light planner with official Environment Canada alerts. Join the beta: %s
Receive severe weather warnings, watches, and advisories for your active city. Severe weather notifications additionally require notifications to be enabled for WeatherAPP in Android system settings.

WeatherAPP can monitor official Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) severe weather warnings in the background and notify you when severe weather threatens your active city.\n\nBackground monitoring and notifications are optional and strictly opt-in.
